lines.text: How can artificial intelligence take a single written sentence and generate a photo-realistic painting in ten seconds?
Modern image generators don't cut and paste pieces from Google Images.
They use an advanced process called latent diffusion, inspired by non-equilibrium thermodynamics.
During training, the AI learns by taking millions of pictures and slowly destroying them with static pixel noise.
It learns to mathematically reverse the degradation, reconstructing clean pictures from pure fuzz.
When you type a prompt, the AI starts with a canvas of random television static, carving out shapes based on your words.
It essentially dreams an image out of mathematical static noise.
